leakageAnalysis.title: Data Leakage Prevention: Pre-Exam Early Warning vs Post-Exam Classification
leakageAnalysis.explanation: FinalGrade is directly thresholded from ExamScore (r = -0.968). Training a model with ExamScore to predict FinalGrade yields ~99.8% artificial accuracy, which represents severe target leakage because ExamScore is unavailable prior to final exams. EduTrack AI separates Pre-Exam Early-Warning prediction (92.2% realistic accuracy using attendance, study hours, assignments, and engagement factors) to enable timely academic interventions.
